title: Intent or need v1
description: config/intent/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F2a): an intention, goal or locked constraint (INT) of the owner, or a need (NEED) that refines one. The intention lives in docs/SEMENTE.md and only Daniel changes it (its §6 lock); a need written by a session enters proposed until he validates it.
